title: NCRIC MOUs, public-agency analysis, re-sharing restrictions
summary:
Asked for SMPD's data-sharing agreements with the Northern California Regional Intelligence Center (NCRIC), any analysis of whether NCRIC qualifies as a 'public agency' under Civil Code §1798.90.5(f), and any records of SMPD restricting NCRIC's onward sharing.

Produced the August 2014 SMPD–NCRIC MOU. Its §9 grants NCRIC authority to execute new sharing agreements without further review or approval by member agencies. The response stated 'no responsive records' for item 3.

policy_promises.quote: ALPR information shall not be sold, shared, or transferred except to another public agency
policy_promises.tests: What records describe the public-agency status of NCRIC's onward recipients, and SMPD's role in approving or restricting them?

filed_because: NCRIC is one of the larger downstream recipients of SMPD's ALPR data. The request asks for the governing agreements, any public-agency analysis, and any records of SMPD acting on its right to restrict onward sharing.
notes: The 2014 MOU §9 language and the 'no responsive records' for item 3 inform follow-up W012663-050426 (NCRIC onward disclosures), which addresses the downstream chain.
